plan.title: Explore data structure and existing workspace artifacts
plan.description: Examine the data directory structure: count images, inspect annotations.json (number of annotations, categories, image sizes), check what's already in yolo_mc/, yolo_sc/, splits/ directories. Look at metadata.json. Understand what previous work has been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of data, existing splits, existing YOLO format data, and understanding of annotation statistics

plan.title: Inspect existing splits and YOLO-format data
plan.description: Check splits/ directory for existing train/val split files. Check yolo_mc/ (multi-class) and yolo_sc/ (single-class) for YOLO-format labels. Verify they match the 90/10 split requirement. Count images and labels in each.
plan.success_criteria: Know if we can reuse existing splits and YOLO data or need to recreate them

plan.title: Analyze annotation distribution and category statistics
plan.description: Compute per-category annotation counts, identify rare vs frequent categories, check corrected annotation ratio, compute average annotations per image, analyze bounding box size distribution relative to image size.
plan.success_criteria: Detailed statistics on category frequency, box sizes, and annotation quality logged

plan.title: Explore reference product images
plan.description: Check data/products/ structure: how many products have reference images, what types (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.), image quality/resolution. Map product codes to category_ids using metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Know reference image coverage per category and image types available

plan.title: Verify and pin package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm. Pin ultralytics==8.1.0 in requirements.txt. Install if needed. Verify CUDA availability and GPU specs.
plan.success_criteria: ultralytics==8.1.0 confirmed, torch 2.x with CUDA confirmed, both A800 GPUs visible

plan.title: Create 90/10 stratified split and COCO-format split files
plan.description: If not already done, write script to split 248 images into ~223 train / ~25 val, stratified by store section (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker), seed=42. Output train_split.json and val_split.json in COCO format. Also create corresponding YOLO-format label directories for both multi-class (357 cats) and single-class.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created with proportional section representation, all annotations preserved per image

plan.title: Write evaluation function for val_score
plan.description: Implement evaluation using pycocotools: (1) detection_mAP@0.5 with all predictions mapped to single category, (2) classification_mAP@0.5 with original category_ids. Compute val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Test with dummy predictions to verify correctness.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function returns correct val_score, tested with known inputs

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n multi-class (nc=357) at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8n with 357 classes at 640px provides a quick baseline, likely val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on the train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs. Evaluate on val split using the evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP, and training time.
plan.success_criteria: Baseline val_score recorded, training completes successfully

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n single-class (nc=1) at 640
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector will have higher detection_mAP than multi-class since it only needs to find boxes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n with nc=1 on train split, imgsz=640, 100 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5. Compare detection recall vs the multi-class model.
plan.success_criteria: Detection-only mAP recorded and compared to multi-class baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8s multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s will improve over YOLOv8n by 3-5 mAP points due to larger capacity
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s nc=357, imgsz=640, 150 epochs. Compare val_score to YOLOv8n baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n

plan.title: YOLOv8m multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m provides better capacity for 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m nc=357, imgsz=640, 200 epochs. Record val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to smaller models

plan.title: YOLOv8l multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8l further improves with more parameters
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l nc=357, imgsz=640, 200 epochs. Record val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to YOLOv8m

plan.title: YOLOv8x multi-class at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x is the largest YOLO model and should give best single-model performance at 640
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=357, imgsz=640, 250 epochs. Record val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to YOLOv8l, identify best model size

plan.title: Best YOLO model at 1280 resolution
plan.hypothesis: Higher resolution (1280) will significantly improve detection of small products on dense shelves, +5-10 mAP
plan.description: Take the best model size from steps 10-13, retrain at imgsz=1280 with appropriate batch size (reduce to fit GPU). Train 300 epochs. Compare val_score to 640 version.
plan.success_criteria: Significant val_score improvement from higher resolution

plan.title: YOLOv8x single-class at 1280
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector at high resolution will have excellent detection recall
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, 300 epochs. Record detection_mAP@0.5. This will be the detection backbone for the two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 > multi-class detection mAP

plan.title: Build DINOv2 embedding pipeline
plan.description: Implement: (1) Extract crops from training images using GT boxes, (2) Extract DINOv2-base embeddings for all crops, (3) Build gallery from training crops + reference product images, (4) Implement kNN classifier (k=5, cosine similarity). Save gallery embeddings as .npy.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery built with embeddings for all categories, kNN classifier functional

plan.title: Two-stage baseline: best detector + DINOv2-base kNN
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings will provide better classification than YOLO for rare categories, improving classification_mAP
plan.description: Run best single-class detector on val images, extract crops, classify with DINOv2-base kNN. Compute val_score. Compare to best multi-class YOLO val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over pure YOLO multi-class approach

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain will outperform either alone
plan.description: For each detection from multi-class YOLO: if YOLO class confidence > threshold, use YOLO class; else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep threshold on val split (0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9). Record best val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Gated approach outperforms both pure YOLO and pure DINOv2 classification

plan.title: kNN hyperparameter tuning
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k and temperature differ from defaults and can improve classification by 1-2 mAP
plan.description: Using best detector + DINOv2-base, sweep k={1,3,5,7,11}, distance weighting (uniform vs inverse-distance), and temperature for softmax voting. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN config identified, val_score improvement logged

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: Different ratios of reference images to training crops affect classification quality
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (a) training crops only, (b) reference images only, (c) both with equal weight, (d) reference images 3x repeated + training crops 2x weighted. Evaluate classification_mAP for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Default NMS IoU=0.7 and conf=0.25 are suboptimal for dense shelves
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8} and confidence threshold {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3} on val split using best model. Record val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal NMS/conf thresholds found, val_score improvement logged

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA (multi-scale + flip) adds 1-2 mAP with no retraining
plan.description: Run best model with augment=True on val split. Compare val_score to non-TTA. Measure inference time increase.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement quantified, inference time still within 300s budget

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on 2000x1500 images will catch small products missed at 1280 resize, +3-5 detection mAP
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split each image into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles (stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Evaluate on val split. Measure inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improvement, inference time within budget

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR (transformer detector) has different error profile from YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=357, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs using ultralytics 8.1.0. Record standalone val_score. Compare to best YOLO.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score recorded, error analysis vs YOLO completed

plan.title: RT-DETR-l single-class training
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l as single-class detector may have different recall characteristics than YOLO
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l nc=1, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Compare detection_mAP to YOLO single-class.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP compared, diversity assessment for ensemble

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling architecturally diverse models (YOLO + RT-DETR) improves detection by 2-4 mAP
plan.description: Run both best YOLO and RT-DETR on val images, merge predictions with WBF (ensemble-boxes). Sweep WBF IoU threshold and model weights. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score > best single model val_score

plan.title: Multi-scale ensemble: same model at 640 + 1280
plan.hypothesis: Running the same model at two scales catches products at different sizes
plan.description: Run best YOLO at both 640 and 1280, merge with WBF. Compare to single-scale. Measure time overhead.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement quantified

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product distinction, +3-5 classification mAP
plan.description: Build gallery with DINOv2-large (ViT-L/14) embeddings. Run kNN classification on val crops. Compare classification_mAP to DINOv2-base. Check model size for budget feasibility.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement quantified, size budget assessed

plan.title: Fine-tuned projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A small MLP trained with ArcFace/SupCon loss on product crops improves embedding discrimination
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, train 2-layer MLP projection head (768->512->256) with ArcFace loss on training crops + reference images. Evaluate classification_mAP improvement on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: Training with higher resolution: 1600 or 1920
plan.hypothesis: Training at 1600+ preserves more product detail than 1280, especially for small items
plan.description: Train best YOLO model at imgsz=1600 with reduced batch size and gradient accumulation. Compare val_score to 1280 training. Monitor GPU memory.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to 1280, feasibility confirmed

plan.title: Extended training: 500-800 epochs
plan.hypothesis: 357 categories need more epochs to converge, especially rare classes
plan.description: Train best model configuration for 500 and 800 epochs (with patience=150). Compare val_score to shorter training. Check for overfitting.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal epoch count identified

plan.title: Close mosaic timing experiment
plan.hypothesis: Longer clean-image fine-tuning at end of training (close_mosaic=100-150) improves final precision
plan.description: Train best model with close_mosaic values of 25, 50, 100, 150. Compare val_scores.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal close_mosaic value identified

plan.title: Label smoothing for multi-class training
plan.hypothesis: Label smoothing=0.1 helps with noisy labels and visually similar categories
plan.description: Train best multi-class model with label_smoothing=0.1 vs 0.0. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of label smoothing quantified

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Pasting reference product images onto shelf backgrounds creates useful synthetic training data for rare categories
plan.description: Implement copy-paste augmentation: for rare categories (<5 annotations), paste reference product images onto random shelf backgrounds with perspective warps. Retrain best model. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement, especially for rare category classification

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting corrected annotations improves training signal quality
plan.description: Duplicate images with corrected=True annotations in training set (2x or 3x). Retrain best model. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from annotation quality weighting

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations reduces sensitivity to exact box boundaries
plan.description: For each detection, extract 4 crops: original, center-zoomed (80%), padded (120%), slight shift. Average DINOv2 embeddings before kNN lookup. Compare classification_mAP to single-crop.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement quantified

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual patch tokens handles partial occlusion better than global embeddings
plan.description: Instead of CLS token, use patch tokens from DINOv2. Implement patch-level matching between query crop and gallery entries. Compare classification_mAP to CLS-token approach.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP compared, computational cost assessed

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Products on the same shelf section are correlated; using co-occurrence improves classification of uncertain detections
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data. For each image, after initial classification, apply Bayesian update using co-occurrence of already-confident detections. Evaluate val_score improvement.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from co-occurrence priors

plan.title: Per-category adaptive confidence thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Some categories are easy to classify confidently, others should fall back to category_id=0
plan.description: For each category, find optimal confidence threshold on val split that maximizes its contribution to classification_mAP. Categories below threshold get category_id=0 (safe for detection score).
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from adaptive thresholds

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling at test time
plan.hypothesis: High-confidence detections on test images can augment the gallery for better classification of repeated products
plan.description: Implement two-pass inference: (1) detect and classify all test images, (2) add high-confidence crops (score>0.85) to DINOv2 gallery, (3) re-classify uncertain detections. Simulate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from pseudo-labeling

plan.title: Rectangular inference (rect=True)
plan.hypothesis: Preserving aspect ratio during inference helps on non-square images
plan.description: Run best model with rect=True on val split. Compare val_score to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared, inference time checked

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE contrast enhancement
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detect products in poorly lit shelf areas
plan.description: Apply CLAHE preprocessing to val images before detection. Compare val_score to unprocessed images.
plan.success_criteria: val_score impact quantified

plan.title: Smaller YOLO with tiling vs larger YOLO without tiling
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with tiling may outperform YOLOv8x without tiling due to higher effective resolution
plan.description: Compare: (a) YOLOv8x at 1280 no tiling, (b) YOLOv8m at 1280 with tiling (4 tiles + full). Measure val_score and inference time.
plan.success_criteria: Best detection strategy identified considering accuracy-speed tradeoff

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO model
plan.hypothesis: INT8 quantization reduces model size by ~50% with <1 mAP loss
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX INT8. Benchmark val_score vs FP16. Measure size reduction and inference speed change.
plan.success_criteria: Size reduction quantified, accuracy loss < 1 mAP

plan.title: INT8 quantization of DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 INT8 may degrade embedding quality significantly since similarity is continuous
plan.description: Export DINOv2 to ONNX INT8. Compare classification_mAP to FP16 version. Assess if the size savings are worth the accuracy cost.
plan.success_criteria: Accuracy impact quantified, decision on whether to use INT8 DINOv2

plan.title: Progressive resizing training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 first then switching to 1280 is faster and may generalize better
plan.description: Train best model: 100 epochs at 640, then resume for 200 epochs at 1280. Compare val_score and total training time to direct 1280 training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score and training efficiency compared

plan.title: Focal loss and class-balanced sampling
plan.hypothesis: Focal loss and oversampling rare classes improves classification of infrequent products
plan.description: Train with focal loss (fl_gamma=1.5 or 2.0) and/or class-balanced image sampling. Compare classification_mAP for rare vs frequent categories.
plan.success_criteria: Impact on rare category classification quantified

plan.title: Build optimized inference pipeline for submission
plan.description: Write run.py that: loads best detector + DINOv2 + gallery, runs tiled/TTA inference if beneficial, classifies with best strategy, outputs COCO-format predictions.json. Ensure it works with pathlib (no os), respects all sandbox restrictions.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct output format, runs within 300s on simulated test set

plan.title: Full pipeline end-to-end timing test
plan.hypothesis: Complete pipeline (detection + classification + post-processing) runs within 300s for ~248 images on L4
plan.description: Simulate submission environment: run full pipeline on val images, extrapolate timing to full test set. Identify bottlenecks. Optimize if needed (batch inference, ONNX runtime, etc.).
plan.success_criteria: Estimated inference time < 300s for full test set

plan.title: ONNX export and validation
plan.hypothesis: ONNX models produce identical results to PyTorch models
plan.description: Export best YOLO and DINOv2 to ONNX (opset ≤ 20, FP16). Run inference with onnxruntime-gpu. Verify predictions match PyTorch outputs. Check total weight file size < 420 MB.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX outputs match PyTorch, total size < 420 MB

plan.title: Ensemble of 3 models with WBF
plan.hypothesis: Three diverse models (YOLO-x, YOLO-l, RT-DETR) ensembled with WBF gives best detection
plan.description: If budget allows, combine 3 models with WBF. Sweep ensemble weights and IoU thresholds. Check if total weight size fits 420 MB (may need INT8 for some).
plan.success_criteria: Best ensemble val_score > best single model, fits size budget

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as additional signal during box fusion improves both detection and classification
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from ensemble, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity between crops. Use similarity as confidence boost for agreeing predictions. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Spatial context features for classification
plan.hypothesis: Including surrounding shelf context in the crop improves product identification
plan.description: Instead of tight crops, extract crops with 20-30% padding. Feed padded crops to DINOv2. Compare classification_mAP to tight crops. The shelf context (neighboring products, shelf labels) may help.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP compared with different padding levels

plan.title: Horizontal position features for classification
plan.hypothesis: Products at similar shelf positions across images are more likely to be the same product
plan.description: Add normalized (x, y) position as features alongside DINOv2 embeddings. Train a simple classifier that uses both visual and spatial features. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from spatial features

plan.title: Store section-aware classification
plan.hypothesis: Knowing the store section (Egg, Frokost, etc.) narrows down possible categories significantly
plan.description: Train a simple image-level section classifier (4 classes). Use predicted section to filter candidate categories for each image. Evaluate classification_mAP improvement.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement from section-aware filtering

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs standard NMS for dense shelves
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS preserves more overlapping detections on dense shelves
plan.description: Replace standard NMS with Soft-NMS (Gaussian or linear decay). Sweep sigma parameter. Compare detection_mAP on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP compared, optimal NMS strategy identified

plan.title: Crops from original resolution vs resized for DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Extracting DINOv2 crops from full-resolution images preserves more detail than from YOLO-resized images
plan.description: Compare classification_mAP when crops are extracted from: (a) original ~2000x1500 images, (b) YOLO-resized 1280px images. Ensure the pipeline uses full-res crops.
plan.success_criteria: Best crop extraction strategy identified

plan.title: Final model selection and configuration documentation
plan.description: Compare all experiment results. Select the configuration with highest val_score. Document: model architecture, training hyperparameters, inference pipeline settings, weight files needed. Prepare final config for human to retrain on full dataset.
plan.success_criteria: Best configuration clearly documented with val_score and all settings

plan.title: Package final submission zip
plan.description: Create submission.zip with: run.py, model weights (.pt or .onnx), gallery embeddings, any helper files. Verify: total size < 420 MB, no blocked imports, correct output format, runs end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: Valid submission zip that passes all format checks

plan.title: Final validation: end-to-end submission test
plan.hypothesis: Final submission produces correct predictions within time and size limits
plan.description: Unzip submission in clean environment, run on val images as if they were test images, verify output format, check timing, confirm val_score matches expectations.
plan.success_criteria: Submission produces expected val_score, runs within 300s, output format correct
